NIT Patna Medical Officer Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Patna Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: NIT Patna Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Patna (NIT Patna) for hiring eligible candidates on a contractual basis in their healthcare department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in NIT Patna recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post under this recruitment drive is Medical Officer. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for qualified medical professionals.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree along with valid registration in a State Medical Council or the Indian Medical Register to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for NIT Patna Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Medical Officer position will receive a monthly consolidated salary ranging between Rs. 80,000/- and Rs. 1,00,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates do not need to apply online or offline beforehand. They can directly appear for the walk-in interview scheduled by the institute.

faq.question: Q6. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer position at NIT Patna is scheduled to take place on 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Main Building, NIT Patna, Ashok Rajpath Campus, Patna - 800005, along with all necessary original documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by candidates attending the walk-in interview as per the details provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their updated biodata, all educational and medical registration certificates in original, along with two sets of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract for this job?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially made for a period of one year on a temporary basis, which may be extended further based on institute requirements and performance.
